scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Uniform central plane sections of the regular Euclidean dodecahedron; exact polygon-side distribution and ninety-two spherical orientation chambers.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Does not cover nongeneric planes, noncentral sections, deformations or joint sectional metric distributions. Older equivalent stereology remains a possible priority risk.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytic reduction to an exhaustive finite algebraic sign certificate and spherical excess; checker included.

title: Exact Haar polygon-type law for central sections of the regular dodecahedron
